title: GEMM dequant fusion + prefetch KV-cache coordinator for hybrid INT8/FP8 paths
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: hot GEMM kernels for quantized inference showed a recurring cost in per-token dequant/scale bookkeeping (scale table lookups and per-layer dequant ops). This PR introduces a fused dequant->GEMM kernel path plus a small KV-cache-coordinated prefetcher for per-layer scale metadata to reduce memory traffic and avoid branchy dequant fallbacks. The goal is to reduce tail latency for short to medium sequences and increase throughput for steady-state streaming workloads under continuous batching, without changing high-level APIs. Approach: 1) Add fused_dequant_gemm kernel implementations for INT8 and FP8 source tensors (runtime/kernels/fused_dequant_gemm.*). The fused kernel consumes quantized weights + precomputed scale factors and emits the GEMM output in the runtime's preferred dense format, eliminating a separate dequant pass. 2) Introduce a ScaleTableCache (runtime/kv_cache/scale_cache.{h,cc}) that stores per-layer quant scales and prefetches them into the local worker memory when a model is loaded or when a new attention key arrives. The cache coordinates with the existing KV cache lifecycle to warm scales ahead of the first token generation. 3) Modify the path allocator and scheduler weight heuristic (runtime/scheduler/path_allocator.cc) to prefer fused paths when sequence length and batch sizes indicate latency-sensitive mode. 4) Continuous batching integration: batching logic updated to mark fused-path-compatible batches and ensure that batching coalescing preserves scale-table locality (runtime/batching/continuous_batcher.cc). 5) Safety: full fallback to the legacy dequant+gemm path if kernel selection fails (hardware mismatch, missing scales, or precision mismatch). Includes feature gate runtime.config.enable_fused_dequant_gemm (default: true for internal clusters; disabled for some legacy GPU tiers until validated). Benchmarks: microbench harness (benchmark/microbench/quant_paths.py) and CI bench runs show median latency down ~18% and 90th percentile down ~25% for representative chat workloads on H100 (sequence length 64, batch=8), throughput increase ~22% on A100 for large batches due to reduced memory bandwidth pressure. Memory working set reduced ~28% when scale tables are hot. Tests & Validation: unit tests added for kernel correctness (tests/unit/fused_dequant_gemm_test.cc), integration quant smoke tests (tests/integration/quant_smoke.py), and correctness cross-precision validation against FP32 reference. CI: initial CI run exposed a numerical mismatch on an early FP8 schedule; fixed by delaying reorder of scale-prefetch for particular kernel tiling (commit "fix: avoid scale reorder for fp8 tiled paths"). Rollout plan: behind feature flag; staged canary across dedicated pools: 1) internal perf canary (5% traffic) for 48h, 2) dedicated reserved clusters (20%) for 72h with regression alarms, 3) global rollout if no regressions found. Related work: ENG-4872 (perf sprint), ENG-4921 (kv-cache lifecycle), SUP-1124 (customer case for low-latency chat). Checklist: [x] Kernel implementation, [x] Scheduler ties, [x] KV-scale cache, [x] microbench harness, [x] unit + integration tests, [x] docs/release note. Security & compatibility: no API surface changes; backward compatible kernel fallback in place. Merge: squash.

docs: release note and rollout instructions
review_comments: Jordan Lee: Can you include a microbenchmark for seq=1 path? We saw tail latency regressions in a prior attempt.

Priya Nair: Please gate FP8 fused path behind config until we validate all H100 variants. Also add a fallback for missing scale metadata.

release_notes: Introduce fused dequant->GEMM kernels with KV-coordinated scale prefetch to reduce latency and increase throughput for INT8/FP8 inference. Default-enabled on validated GPU tiers; safe fallback to legacy path. Rollout staged to canaries. See docs/release_notes/41203.md for details and canary hooks.
benchmark_summary: H100 (seq=64,batch=8): median latency -18%, p90 -25%. A100 (large batch): throughput +22%. Working set reduced ~28% with hot scale cache. Bench harness and raw results in tools/perf/bench_runner.py outputs.
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged rollout: 5% internal canary for 48h -> 20% dedicated clusters for 72h -> global rollout if no regressions. Automatic fallback triggers on latency or correctness alarms. Ops runbook updated in docs/release_notes/41203.md.
notes_on_compat: No API changes. Kernel selection is runtime-local; older clients unaffected. Legacy dequant+gemm path retained as fallback to preserve bit-exact behavior where required. Feature flag controls activation per cluster tier.
